WITH
  sales_returns AS (
    SELECT
      ss.ss_customer_sk,
      ss.ss_item_sk,
      ss.ss_ticket_number,
      MAX(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
      MAX(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss
    FROM
      store_sales AS ss
      JOIN store_returns AS sr ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    WHERE
      d1.d_moy = 4 AND d1.d_year = 1999 AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY
      ss.ss_customer_sk,
      ss.ss_item_sk,
      ss.ss_ticket_number
  ),

  catalog_data AS (
    SELECT
      cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
      cs.cs_item_sk,
      MAX(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
    FROM
      catalog_sales AS cs
    WHERE
      d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d3.d_year = 1999 AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY
      cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
      cs.cs_item_sk
  ),

  joined_data AS (
    SELECT
      i_item_id,
      i_item_desc,
      s_store_id,
      s_store_name,
      sales_returns.store_sales_profit,
      sales_returns.store_returns_loss,
      catalog_data.catalog_sales_profit,
      store.s_store_sk,
      store_sales.ss_item_sk,
      store_sales.ss_ticket_number
    FROM
      store JOIN item ON store.s_store_sk = item.i_store_sk
      JOIN store_sales ON store.s_store_sk = store_sales.ss_store_sk AND item.i_item_sk = store_sales.ss_item_sk
      JOIN sales_returns ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = sales_returns.sr_customer_sk AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = sales_returns.sr_item_sk AND store_sales.ss_ticket_number = sales_returns.sr_ticket_number
      JOIN catalog_data ON sales_returns.ss_bill_customer_sk = catalog_data.cs_bill_customer_sk AND sales_returns.ss_item_sk = catalog_data.cs_item_sk
      JOIN date_dim AS d1 ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
      JOIN date_dim AS d2 ON sales_returns.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
      JOIN date_dim AS d3 ON catalog_data.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  )
SELECT
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name,
  sales_returns.store_sales_profit,
  sales_returns.store_returns_loss,
  catalog_data.catalog_sales_profit
FROM
  joined_data
WHERE
  d1.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d1.d_year = 1999 AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d2.d_year = 1999 AND d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d3.d_year = 1999
ORDER BY
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name
LIMIT 100
